Victory Corner is a place I often visit in the evening. The market is small, not too crowded but bustling enough with lots of delicious street food at reasonable prices. The atmosphere here is comfortable, easy to walk around, suitable for experiencing local life and light shopping. If you like to explore fun, affordable but still safe places, this is a place worth trying when coming to Bangkok.
Evening at the Saxophone Jazz Club. Good food and excellent music. A great band every night and a big band on Sundays.

A quiet, yet not-quiet place where you can witness the daily lives of locals. I came here again to transfer from Don Mueang to BTS. And on my way back, I came back to visit Saxophone Pub. A place that I really like.
